commit_message: build: establish local NG contract bootstrap

repair_round1.verdict_out: all seven resolved against the reviewed bytes; approved design and working behavior preserved; no redesign, no weakened tests

dispositions.change: src/ptest/files.py validate_single_name is now the structural check the design specifies: rejects non-str/empty, '.', '..', '/', NUL and other C0 controls/DEL; accepts spaces, Unicode, brackets. O_NOFOLLOW descriptor-relative traversal is unchanged as the safety boundary.
dispositions.evidence: .pipeline/local/red-repair1-findings.log (RED: unsafe-path on Application Support and spaced/bracketed names) then .pipeline/local/green-repair.log (GREEN 68 passed)

dispositions.change: src/ptest/files.py _walk_to_parent now closes every intermediate descriptor on the success path; only the returned parent fd (or root_fd for single-component paths) stays open for the caller. Error-path cleanup unchanged.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_files.py: test_nested_read_success_keeps_descriptors_stable (200 depth-3 reads), test_nested_failure_keeps_descriptors_stable (100 failed reads + 100 failed creates); small deterministic /proc/self/fd accounting, no fsync loops

dispositions.change: src/ptest/contracts.py serialize_run_result emits the document top-level mode from result.mode (was plan.mode); plan.mode stays in the nested plan object.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_contracts.py: test_command_summary_withholds_every_token_form now builds a RunResult (mode SHADOW vs plan AUTOMATIC, secret argv, populated sequence/input_before/input_after/policy_digest) and runs it through serialize_run_result + encode + decode, asserting round-tripped mode, internal-field absence and sentinel absence

dispositions.change: src/ptest/contracts.py is now one descriptor authority: shared schema builders (_capability/_counts/_timings/_attempt/_readiness/_finding/_lease/_obligation/_scan_limits/_scan_usage schemas) reused by PUBLIC_SCHEMAS, matching strict decode validators (_check_capability_dict et al. with exact required keys, no extras), and shared record converters (_capability_dict/_command_dict/_plan_dict/_counts_dict/_timings_dict/_attempt_dict/_readiness_dict/_finding_dict/_lease_dict/_obligation_dict/_scan_limits_dict/_scan_usage_dict) reused by serialize_run_result/_prepared_dict and test fixtures. where.capability is the frozen Capability object (execution/selection/lifecycle/limitations) instead of a bare tier string. Unspecified shapes stay objects: where/status effective_limits, history summaries, init config. Regenerated docs/schemas/v1/*.json via scripts/export-schemas.py.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_contracts.py: test_eight_public_documents_parse uses fully populated record-built fixtures of all eight kinds; test_generated_schema_files_match_frozen_shapes asserts independent on-disk schema expectations; test_frozen_subrecord_negatives_rejected (string capability, empty lease, bad severity, mistyped counts, timings-less attempt, unknown reason code, smuggled extra key)

dispositions.change: src/ptest/contracts.py decode_public_document/decode_control_frame/decode_launch_manifest catch RecursionError alongside ValueError/UnicodeDecodeError and map it to the same typed Problem; _check_nesting is iterative so the bound check itself cannot recurse. Strict length/nonce/version checks retained.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_contracts.py: test_frame_nesting_past_declared_bound_rejected (20-deep vs bound 16), test_frame_pathological_nesting_is_typed_rejection, test_document_pathological_nesting_is_typed_rejection, test_manifest_pathological_nesting_is_typed_rejection (20000-deep, bodies inside byte limits)
dispositions.evidence: pre-fix direct probe: 20000-deep frame raised bare RecursionError (see repair evidence); post-fix .pipeline/local/green-repair.log (GREEN)

dispositions.change: src/ptest/contracts.py five private decoder sites now raise fixed machine messages (control frame payload / manifest domain / grant / attempt / body failed validation) instead of interpolating constructor exception text; encode_public_document still copies only the four allowlisted Problem fields.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_contracts.py: test_manifest_decoder_hides_offending_values (tampered manifest with sentinel-bearing option asserts sentinel absent from str(problem) and from the encoded public error document), test_control_frame_decoder_hides_offending_values

dispositions.change: tests/ng/support.py CaseFactory.invoke keeps its mandated default --result-json injection but now targets a project-root unique file (ptest-result-<hex>.json) whose parent already exists, so exclusive creation needs no mkdir chain and no longer reuses the orchestrator .pipeline/local name. No production CLI/scheduler stub was added; ptest.cli:main stays the T11-owned declaration and no code depends on an absent ptest.__main__.
dispositions.tests: tests/ng/test_files.py: test_invoke_default_export_roundtrip_with_miniature_target exercises argument assembly (--fixture-domain, default --result-json), CONTROL_VARS stripping (PTEST_CONFIG deliberately set to bogus-override) and export read-back against a test-only miniature ptest package served via PYTHONPATH with an explicit 20s timeout
dispositions.evidence: .pipeline/local/t07-cli-absent.log (python -m ptest exit 1: No module named ptest.__main__); .pipeline/local/green-repair.log (GREEN)

review_notes_closed: ControlFrame payload values validated for every kind in _require_frame_keys (cancel signal, parent-closing empty, registered guard identity, phase values, runner-facts field types, draining artifact id); covered by test_control_frame_values_validated_per_kind
Capability.limitations now requires Reason entries (TypeError otherwise); covered by test_capability_limitations_require_reason_records

storage.open_database closes the connection on typed pragma failures too (except Problem re-raise path) and read-only file: URIs are percent-escaped; covered by test_open_database_closes_connection_on_pragma_rejection and test_open_database_read_only_escapes_special_characters

create_exclusive maps ENOENT to state-unavailable, EACCES/EPERM/EROFS to state-unavailable, ENOSPC/EDQUOT to capacity-exceeded; ELOOP stays unsafe-path; covered by test_create_exclusive_missing_parent_is_typed_absence
.gitignore now ignores *.egg-info/ and graphify-out/; generated artifacts no longer show as untracked
bootstrap frozen-hash routing and --full refusal untouched

dan_passes.pass1_reread: Re-read bootstrap/storage/files bytes end-to-end (initial). New observations: os.write partial-write risk in wrapper config (fixed with write loop); FIFO read-open wedge (fixed with O_NONBLOCK); obscure manifest decode expression (fixed to iterate attempts directly, 1-line diff proven vs backup); unused except variable (fixed). Repair round 1 re-read of the full git diff: intermediate-fd close guard (item is not fd) is defensive but harmless; _check_attempt_dict reuses _check_str_list on a singleton for the id type check; schema builders and validators share the same field sets; no leftover allowlist references; no unrelated edits.
dan_passes.pass2_reanchor: All 5 Task0 checkboxes MET with file:line evidence: wrapper scripts/ptest-bootstrap:100-128; 7 APIs src/ptest/files.py; opener src/ptest/storage.py; records/codecs src/ptest/contracts.py; helpers tests/ng/support.py + conftest.py; exporter scripts/export-schemas.py; schemas docs/schemas/v1/*.json + runtime/protocol-v1.json. No scope expansion: no scheduler/runner/config/platform/cli code; T0-4 subrecord freeze restores design section 6 shapes without new public surface (converters are underscore-private); T0-7 keeps the mandated default export, no production stub.
dan_passes.pass3_smells: Single definitions verified by search; no duplicate sqlite3.connect outside storage.py; support.py imports only contracts+files (no T2 platform); no TODO/stubs; 2 additive codes (already-exists, invalid-bound) documented in REASON_CODES; CORRECTION to the prior claim: private protocol decoders DID interpolate constructor text into Problem.message (Opus T0-6) — now fixed to five constant messages, verified by sentinel tests; files.py messages carry only caller-supplied names/paths, never exception text or argv. Empty/error/repeat paths covered by tests; no new dependencies; no shims.
